svg.title: Industrial gross value added in mainland Spain by NUTS 3 province, 2019
svg.desc: Five published classes from Montanía et al. (2024), Figure 1, p. 12, based on the European Commission ARDECO database (2022 vintage). Class ranges are shown in billions of constant 2015 euros, rounded to two decimals. The data class for each province was read from Figure 1. Eurostat GISCO 2021 NUTS 3 polygons, © EuroGeographics. Valencia belongs to the highest class. Adapted under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

g.text: Industrial value added in 2019 (billions of 2015 euros)
